headline: Dil Raju calls Ranbir Kapoor ‘Ranveer Singh’ at Ramayana’s grand Hyderabad event; immediately apologizes: “Sorry, Ranbir Kapoor garu!”
caption:
Dil Raju Ranbir Kapoor Ranveer Singh Ramayana event 🎬

headline: Jackie Shroff attends event with Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis a day after attack on son Tiger Shroff
caption:
Jackie Shroff Tiger Shroff firing Devendra Fadnavis Bappi Lahiri Marg event
Tiger par firing ke ek din baad Jackie Shroff Mumbai me CM Fadnavis aur Suniel Shetty ke saath dikhe.
Ye firing ke baad Jackie ki pehli public appearance thi. Teeno aropi Rajasthan Police ne Kota Junction par train se pakde.
Fadnavis bole: hamla karne wale kayar bakhshe nahi jayenge. Aapko kya lagta hai, sakht action hona chahiye? 👇🔥
